description: This is a PHP source file defining a class Map within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Model.Extension.Opencart.Dashboard. The class extends a system engine model and includes a method getTotalOrdersByCountry that retrieves aggregated order data by country from the database, including total order counts and amounts.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: Represents a model for dashboard map statistics, extending the core system model class.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Retrieves total order counts and sum amounts grouped by country, filtered by complete statuses and payment country ID conditions.
